newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Troika Dialog sees growth from IFC loan.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Troika Dialog sees growth from IFC loan.

text.p: Troika Dialog plans to at least double the volume of its trading operations on the Russian securities market with the help of an International Finance Corporation $10 million loan, Troika said on Tuesday.
"We just want to grow," Troika finance director Tatyana Sigaryova told Reuters.

Troika Dialog, the investment banking arm of Dialog Bank, is one of the leading companies on the Russian securities market, dealing in equities and government securities, and providing corporate finance and asset management services.
Sigaryova said only part of the credit would be used to increase market operations volume. Troika will use the rest to increase shareholders' funds.
The investment includes a long-term credit line and a long-term credit convertible into Troika Dialog shares.
Sigaryova declined to say how many shares IFC could acquire if the credit was fully converted.
"We can only say that it is a small package of shares, the purchase of which cannot be characterised as acquiring control over the company," Sigaryova said.
Troika Dialog and the IFC, the private-sector arm of the World Bank, will sign the credit agreement on October 2 in Washington.
